description: This file provides quantized functional implementations for various neural network operations in PyTorch, including pooling, convolution, activation functions, interpolation, and other utilities. It acts as an interface to perform quantized operations on tensors, mainly used within the PyTorch quantization framework.

methods.name: avg_pool2d( input, kernel_size, stride=None, padding=0, ceil_mode=False, count_include_pad=True, divisor_override=None, )
methods.description: Applies 2D average pooling operation for quantized tensors, propagating quantization parameters.

methods.name: avg_pool3d( input, kernel_size, stride=None, padding=0, ceil_mode=False, count_include_pad=True, divisor_override=None, )
methods.description: Applies 3D average pooling operation for quantized tensors.

methods.name: Tensor adaptive_avg_pool2d(input: Tensor, output_size: BroadcastingList2[int])
methods.description: Applies adaptive 2D average pooling to quantized input.

methods.name: Tensor adaptive_avg_pool3d(input: Tensor, output_size: BroadcastingList2[int])
methods.description: Applies adaptive 3D average pooling to quantized input.

methods.name: conv1d( input, weight, bias, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1, padding_mode="zeros", scale=1.0, zero_point=0, dtype=torch.quint8, )
methods.description: Performs 1D convolution on quantized input tensors with optional scale and zero point adjustments.

methods.name: conv2d( input, weight, bias, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1, padding_mode="zeros", scale=1.0, zero_point=0, dtype=torch.quint8, )
methods.description: Performs 2D convolution on quantized tensors with optional quantization parameters.

methods.name: conv3d( input, weight, bias, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1, padding_mode="zeros", scale=1.0, zero_point=0, dtype=torch.quint8, )
methods.description: Performs 3D convolution on quantized tensors with quantization support.

methods.name: interpolate( input, size=None, scale_factor=None, mode="nearest", align_corners=None )
methods.description: Performs downsampling or upsampling of quantized tensors, supporting resize via size or scale factor.

methods.name: Tensor linear( input: Tensor, weight: Tensor, bias: Tensor | None = None, scale: float | None = None, zero_point: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Applies a quantized linear transformation, using packed weights and optional per-tensor quantization parameters.

methods.name: max_pool1d( input, kernel_size, stride=None, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False, return_indices=False, )
methods.description: Performs 1D max pooling on quantized inputs.

methods.name: max_pool2d( input, kernel_size, stride=None, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False, return_indices=False, )
methods.description: Performs 2D max pooling on quantized inputs.

methods.name: Tensor celu(input: Tensor, scale: float, zero_point: int, alpha: float = 1.0)
methods.description: Applies the quantized CELU activation element-wise.

methods.name: leaky_relu( input: Tensor, negative_slope: float = 0.01, inplace: bool = False, scale: float | None = None, zero_point: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Quantized LeakyReLU activation with optional rescaling.

methods.name: Tensor hardtanh( input: Tensor, min_val: float = -1.0, max_val: float = 1.0, inplace: bool = False )
methods.description: Quantized hardtanh activation function.

methods.name: Tensor hardswish(input: Tensor, scale: float, zero_point: int)
methods.description: Quantized HardSwish activation.

methods.name: Tensor threshold(input: Tensor, threshold: float, value: float)
methods.description: Quantized thresholding operation.

methods.name: Tensor elu(input: Tensor, scale: float, zero_point: int, alpha: float = 1.0)
methods.description: Quantized ELU activation.

methods.name: Tensor hardsigmoid(input: Tensor, inplace: bool = False)
methods.description: Quantized HardSigmoid activation.

methods.name: Tensor clamp(input: Tensor, min_: float, max_: float)
methods.description: Clamps quantized tensor values between a min and max.

methods.name: upsample(input, size=None, scale_factor=None, mode="nearest", align_corners=None)
methods.description: Deprecated upsample function, forwarding to interpolate.

methods.name: upsample_bilinear(input, size=None, scale_factor=None)
methods.description: Deprecated bilinear upsampling, forwarding to interpolate.

methods.name: upsample_nearest(input, size=None, scale_factor=None)
methods.description: Deprecated nearest neighbor upsampling, forwarding to interpolate.
